I think CWE mapping is not useful/valuable at the moment. Sometimes it's useful to validate, is it correlating with ASVS requirement text but in big picture - is this mapping actually used?

At the moment we have mapped requirements to obsoleted categories, to views, etc.

[CWE-16](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/16.html) section Notes:
> Use for Mapping: Prohibited (this CWE ID must not be used to map to real-world vulnerabilities). Categories are informal organizational groupings of weaknesses that help navigation and browsing by CWE users, but they are not weaknesses in themselves [REF-1287]. ... Mapping is also Prohibited because this entry's status is Obsolete.


List of ASVS requirements where mapping points to CWE which type is `view` or `category` (not `weakness`) and/or status is obsolete

* [CWE-16](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/16.html) status:obsolete; type:category; ASVS: 2.5.4, 3.4.4, 3.4.5, 10.3.1, 14.1.3
* [CWE-19](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/19.html) status:draft; type:category; ASVS: 8.1.5, 8.1.6
* [CWE-255](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/255.html) status:draft; type:category; ASVS: 2.10.2
* [CWE-265](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/265.html) status:incomplete; type:category; ASVS: 1.14.5, 14.2.6
* [CWE-275](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/275.html) status:draft; type:category; ASVS: 1.4.5
* [CWE-310](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/310.html) status:draft; type:category; ASVS: 2.6.3, 2.7.6, 6.2.1
* [CWE-320](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/320.html) status:obsolete; type:category; ASVS: 1.6.1, 1.6.2, 1.6.3, 1.6.4, 2.8.2, 2.9.1, 6.4.2
* [CWE-1002](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1002.html) status:incomplete; type:category; ASVS: 14.1.6
* [CWE-1008](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1008.html) status:incomplete; type:view; ASVS: 9.4.4
* [CWE-1009](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1009.html) status:draft; type:category; ASVS: 1.7.1
* [CWE-1026](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1026.html) status:incomplete; type:view; ASVS: 14.2.1
* [CWE-1029](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1029.html) status:incomplete; type:category; ASVS: 1.5.1

Additionally we have at the moment 63 ASVS requirements without CWE mapping.

If we think we need CWE mapping, then there are some questions to solve before fixing the mapping:

  * do we accept mapping to CWE views and/or categories
  * do we keep 1:1 relation, or we move to one-to-many solution

For example, Path traversal, in ASVS we have one requirement for that, but there are plenty of CWE values available for Path traversal - basically from CWE-22 to CWE-57.
